watches.name: TYPE 37MOD
watches.description: The final hurrah for the Mark I Type 37HW Type 37HW is our debut model and, naturally, it carries great significance for us. And so, we decided we did not want to let it go out without a proper send-off party. To mark the occasion, we took the final 20 Types 37HW in Forest Green and modified them with a sodalite stone dial. The result is Type 37MOD, for “modified”. This final hurrah for the Mark I Type 37HW strips the dial of its hour markers and minute track. The bottom layer of this two-piece dial is media-blasted silver-lacquered brass, while the top layer is a beautiful, wafer-thin slice of vibrant sodalite. We have only 20 pieces available, and each set includes the original Forest Green dial. Should you ever get bored with your sodalite, you can have your dial swapped by any skilled watchmaker of your choice. Your sodalite dial will feature a unique mixture of blues, lilacs, lavenders, white streaks, and possibly even orange traces. Compared to the original Delft Blue dial, this sodalite dial appears brighter, more vibrant, and more purplish. 20 Pieces available for immediate delivery.

watches.name: TYPE 39VM
watches.description: Our vision of a dive watch for everyday wearing Stock note: Frost: Some pieces remaining until the second half of the production arrives in January. Graphite: Sold out until second half of stock arrives in January . Type 39VM is VPC Watch Co.’s sophomore release — our vision of the archetypal dive watch shaped by Venustas Per Constantiam : beauty through restraint. Within the VPC philosophy, beauty and function are developed together. Not as “form follows function,” and not as decoration layered onto engineering, but as a single, coherent design process. Many modern dive watches drift toward excess: larger cases, glossy surfaces, complex calibers, and visual noise. Type 39VM deliberately moves in the opposite direction. It explores how the clarity and restraint of mid-century dive watches might have evolved today, using modern materials and manufacturing, without becoming luxury statements. Type 39VM ( Viator Maris , traveler of the sea) builds on the design language of Type 37HW, sharing its core case geometry and full compatibility across bracelets and straps. Matte, textured dials prioritize legibility over embellishment. Typography was drawn specifically for the dial and ceramic bezel, optimized for clarity and beauty on a circular plane. Sharply curved lugs, record-breaking thinness, and a supremely supple bracelet define how the watch wears — confident, subtle, elegant. Don’t be fooled, though…Type 39VM will happily accompany you on your most challenging dives. Limited to 300 pieces.

watches.name: TYPE 37HW
watches.description: Our vision of a Go Anywhere Do Anything watch Type 37HW is our debut model, and our vision of a Go Anywhere Do Anything watch. Our aim was to unite technical prowess and aesthetic elegance by questioning some of the industry-standard features and solutions. Why not pair a screw-down crown and a hand-winding caliber? Why not find a neater way to marry a case and a bracelet? Why not maximize both water resistance and thinness? Well, Type 37HW is the result of seeking answers to all those questions. Type 37HW is available in three colors: Dove Grey, Forest Green, and Delft Blue. 100 of each are produced, uniquely numbered as “xxx/300 – 2024 debut batch”. Once sold out, these versions will be retired to the VPC Archives. Future versions will come with different dials and new details and will, therefore, always be unique. 37.5mm hand-wound chronometer with hard-coated stainless steel case, bracelet, and clasp. Our 7 design principles
